title: sphenandra viscosa
intro: Sphenandra viscosa, commonly known as "climbing spikenard", is a perennial climber that belongs to the family Cucurbitaceae. It is native to tropical Africa and has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Sphenandra viscosa include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
